assumptions: Ratchets are rehearsed at the ratchet script (synthetic report + fixture baseline), not at the upstream harness analyzers, which need the network-installed floating-major CLI.
The duration ratchet is probed through its exported compare(), because its CLI hard-codes the repo baseline path.
Fixtures live at repo-root rehearsal/, because blackhawk and savant skip fixtures/ directories and the strict dogfood steps scan ts/test and agents/skills/test.
The gate is a blocking step in the existing skills-validate job (after the engine build), not a new required check, so ruleset contexts are unchanged.
The ts unit suite runs the six offline probes; canary-cassandra needs a built engine, so its probe is exercised end to end by the CI step, whose wiring the suite asserts.
entryPoints edits are append-only (end of each array) so the rebase against open PRs #947 and #949 stays trivial.

No excludePatterns entry for rehearsal/: ts/test/entropy-exclude-patterns.test.ts forbids a repo-rooted exclude over tracked files (it would shrink the CI denominator). Fixture code files are *.test.mjs, already excluded; the rest are JSON/txt/diff data.
